Many liberals are claiming His Majesty King William I as a despotic ruler. Unemployment and industrial unrest in the working classes has also contributed to the turmoil. Riots have erupted in Brussels, shops looted, theatergoers joined the movement right after watching the nationalistic opera La muette de Portici. These rebels soon have started talking about secession and the States-General in Brussels voted in favor of secession and declared independence. It's time to decide what are we going to do about this situation.

The Congress of the Union has proposed a bill to secularize all Californian missions, transferring ownership form the Franciscan Order of the Catholic Church to the Mexican authorities. This is because of potential Spanish influence and power in California because most Spanish missions in California are still loyal to the Roman Catholic Church in Spain.
